verdict.rationale: Ollama's own marketing says prompts are never tracked or trained on, and that local runs never leave the machine. That implies the local product does not collect prompt data, but no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control is documented, and usage telemetry beyond prompts is not addressed. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting or flag, an explicit statement covering usage analytics (not just prompts), clarity on cloud-mode tracking, and independent or hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Your prompts are never tracked or trained on.
Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
